newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - MAIC started as outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - MAIC started as outperform.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said it initiated coverage of MAIC Holdings Inc with an outperform rating for the both the intermediate six months and the long-term 18 month periods.

-- It said the Birmingham, Ala.-based property-casualty insurance company is rapidly expanding through acquisitions. Rapid premium growth of 46 percent in 1995 and 23 percent in the first nine months of 1996 is not yet reflected in the stock's valuation, EVEREN noted in a report.
-- EVEREN's price targets are $41 intermediate and $57, long-term.
